svg.title: Norm and weak-star generator domains for a diagonal action
svg.desc: For T(t)x[n]=exp(i n t)x[n], D(A)={x:n x[n] tends to zero} is strictly contained in D(delta)={x:sup n|x[n]| is finite}, which is strictly contained in c0, which is strictly contained in ell-infinity. The witnesses for those strict inclusions are 1/n, 1/sqrt(n), and 1, respectively. Both domains have norm closure c0 and weak-star closure ell-infinity.

g.text: One diagonal action, two derivative domains
T(t)x[n] = exp(i n t) x[n], n = 1, 2, ...
Norm derivative on c0; every finite-support sequence belongs.
Both domains: norm closure = c0; weak-star closure = ell-infinity.
Each witness lies in its box and outside the next inner box.
